critical_code_review_comments: Outreach send/_send_single_outreach persists status='failed' but does NOT include the Brevo error message in the invitation row — operationally hard to debug. Consider storing a short failure_reason field.

/api/outreach/never-contact accepts the JWT in a GET query string. JWTs in URLs leak via referer headers and proxy logs. Acceptable since this is an opt-out (no privilege escalation) but worth a comment noting the trade-off.

_outreach_can_send counts sent_today by sender_id+sent_at>=24h-ago via ISO-string comparison. Works because ISO-8601 is lexicographically sortable, but a $expr with $toDate would be more robust against missing/legacy rows.
OUTREACH_DAILY_LIMIT=500 hard-coded — could be env-driven for staged ramp.
CreateProductRequest.apply_for_growth defaults to False (good). Server only promotes when both apply_for_growth=True AND support_needed=True — matches spec.
/api/admin/outreach/list uses {sender_id: admin.id} for non-super_admin — correct scoping.
CSV parse: 'header skip' uses 'no @ in any column' heuristic — a row like 'a,b' with no @ would be silently dropped. Acceptable for invite-list CSVs but flag for future hardening.
Backend lookups all consistently exclude {_id:0}. No ObjectId leak observed in any outreach response. ✓
